title_en: The Future of Software Engineering Is Not Less Human — It Is More Intentional
dek_en: A panel on how AI is reshaping software engineering argues that seniority is shifting from writing difficult code to understanding systems, framing problems, and evaluating AI output — and that the biggest risk is "cognitive surrender", accepting AI answers without understanding them.
title_zh: AI 时代的软件工程，不是更少的人，而是更强的判断力
dek_zh: 一场关于 AI 如何重塑软件工程的圆桌讨论指出：高级工程师的核心正从"写复杂代码"转向理解系统、拆解问题、评估 AI 产出，而最大的风险是"认知投降"——不加思考地接受 AI 生成的答案。
